name: rivalrush
description: RivalRush — Quick games. Real rivals. Telegram Mini App monorepo.

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,web -c gray,blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @rivalrush/shared" "npm run dev -w @rivalrush/server" "npm run dev -w @rivalrush/web"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @rivalrush/server && npm run build -w @rivalrush/web
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.verify: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
